quest.title: Spike Self-Circulation Report: Conclusion
quest.description: Now that you have transported the Spike to the deepest section, all that is left to do is to activate it and close the Ley Line rupture.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: The Spike's adjustments have been completed. I'm still a little worried, but we can only leave it there in the tunnels.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I've asked Khedive to make some medicine for Tu and Hao as well.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: #It's all up to you now, {NICKNAME}... initialize the Spike and seal the openings through which the dark mud is gushing out.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Honestly, when Khedive first came to me for help, I thought to myself that I'd just pack the Spike up and head to Sumeru if things didn't work out.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: In any case, we had done enough experiments on the Pursina's Spikes already, more than enough to have data that could support a full report.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: But Tu and Hao... If I just left them here, they would have to deal with this dangerous dark mud for the rest of their lives.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I decided that if my research could not help them, and was only good for publishing reports, then it would not be worth very much at all.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: That's why I decided to find some way to stop the Ley Lines from spewing this mud. I must admit... that coming into contact with this dark mud was something of a wake-up call for me as well...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: #I believe in your strength, but the areas where the mud flows freely are still very dangerous, so be careful, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: I was talking about you. The Spike can indeed decrease the effect the mud has on the monsters if deployed at the Ley Line ruptures.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: But the monsters that have been attracted thereto are just too numerous...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: So please, you have to take care of yourself.

choices.text: I'll take care of the Spike.

talks.objective: Activate the Pursina's Spike and close the Ley Line rupture
